critique_history.assessment:
- Raised growth-ring curves extend beyond the shell margins, creating large floating wire loops; replace them with surface-integrated corrugation.
- The outer pattern reads as a jagged checkerboard rather than concentric brown-and-cream growth bands.
- Several radial accents hover across the open cavity instead of following attached shell surfaces.
- Preserve the fan silhouette and hinge, but use cleaner scalloped rims, radial ribs, and continuous dark interiors.
The model clearly presents two attached, partially open fan-shaped valves with strong radial texture, scalloped edges, brown-and-cream growth bands, and a darker interior.
